reference.reference: 400 complete view/lighting segments of the unchanged field and lighting equations; 800 segments check convergence. Linear premultiplied RGBA and displayed pixels. Integration fidelity, not photographic equivalence.

cost.method: 120 unmeasured renders per variant before ABBA full-frame GPU queries; 20 warmup and 120 measured renders per window; fixed ultra 1280 x 800, no frame cache or adaptive resolution.

decision: Rejected: lower magnified-limb integration error, but full-frame GPU cost increases at ordinary views with negligible visual benefit. Runtime restored to released 0.69.0.
